title: OpenCode – Open source AI coding agent

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI can now write code faster than you can type?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenSource AI tools are breaking barriers in the coding world.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that writes code on its own.
